---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the instrument or the site
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What & why**
What would you like to see, and what problem does it solve? One or two sentences.

> Proposing a new **metric** to track? Use the "Propose a metric" template
> instead — it walks through the `metric_meta` workflow.

**How it fits**
Which part of the instrument does this touch? (a channel, the dial, the margins,
the API, a badge, docs, …)

**Non-financial check**
Ethereum Beat is about protocol health and usage — no prices, market cap or
trading framing. Confirm this fits that scope, or explain the angle.

**Anything else**
Mockups, references, or prior discussion. If you'd like feedback before writing
an issue, start a thread in
[Discussions](https://github.com/ethereumbeat/ethereum-beat/discussions).
